question.text: Where a person has been declared not 'fit and proper' by SEBI and no specific period is mentioned in the order, for how long is such person ineligible to apply for registration?

answer.text: Three years from the date of effect of the order
Ten years from the date of effect of the order
Five years from the date of effect of the order

explanation.text: The Logic: As per the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, where SEBI has declared a person not fit and proper and the order does not specify any period, such person shall not be eligible to apply for any registration for a period of five years from the date of effect of the order. The Trap: Three years, ten years, and permanent ineligibility are plausible distractors, but the regulation prescribes a specific five-year default period when no other duration is mentioned in the order. Note: Workbook reference: NISM Series III-C p.108. Where the SEBI order itself specifies a different period, that specified period overrides the five-year default.
